commit: fix(cli): fix exit code and result message when the parser cannot be inferred

truth.description: handleError in format.js now reads the --ignore-unknown flag as context.argv["ignore-unknown"], but parseArgv in parse-cli-arguments.js, the only producer of context.argv, stores every flag under its camel-cased name, so that half of the guard is always false and prettier --check --ignore-unknown on explicit files, a glob or stdin now reports each file with no inferable parser as an error and exits with 2 instead of skipping it.

distractions.why: FOO has no inferable parser and this run passes no flag to skip unknown files, so the error on it sets exit code 2 even though --write fixed foo.js.
